capabilities: look up double-clicked or selected words in notes and PDFs
explain and translate text with AI providers like DeepSeek
collect looked-up words into a vocabulary notebook with context
review words with SM-2 spaced repetition flashcards
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README; states the plugin is for personal learning only and that dictionary data comes from third-party web APIs (Youdao web interface, Wiktionary) whose rights remain with their owners. Also installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary or vocabulary-study tool, so readers cannot look up or memorize words they encounter in notes and PDFs.
